title: Pricing page with three tiers
request: Create a pricing page with three plans — Starter, Team and Enterprise — a short FAQ underneath about billing, and a final call to action.
rubric: Are there three distinguishable plans with prices, and does the FAQ answer billing questions a buyer would actually ask?
why: Pricing is the shape that most often needs child nodes (pricingPlan) inside a parent, so it catches a planner that can only insert flat top-level sections.
